newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Reaal and SNS plan insurance/banking merger.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Reaal and SNS plan insurance/banking merger.

text.p: Unlisted Dutch insurer Reaal Groep NV and unlisted Dutch bank SNS Groep NV said on Thursday they were exploring the possibility of a complete merger.
If the merger goes through it would create a Dutch financial group with total assets of almost 40 billion guilders.

"Reaal Groep NV of Utrecht and SNS Groep NV of 's-Hertogenbosch have decided to start an inquiry into the possibilities for a complete cooperation of both companies," Reaal and SNS said in a joint statement.
The study would focus on the joint development of the "all-finance" and "multi-channel" concepts for financial services, the statement said.
"Reaal and SNS complement each other in the field of product range, know-how, labels, distribution channels and structure of total income," the two companies said.
Because of this, a merger was not expected to lead to job cuts, they added.
Dutch merger and regulatory authorities have been informed of the plans and the merger study is expected to be completed in the first half of 1997.

Predominantly insurance-based financial group. Main insurance brands are Reeal, Hooge Huys, Proteq. Main banking units are ASN Bank and Hollandse Koopmansbank. In 1995 87 pct of total income came from insurance, 13 pct from banking. Total 1995 insurance income was 2.04 billion guilders. At end of 1995 Reaal Groep NV had total assets of 11.76 billion guilders and equity capital of 559 million. In 1995 average number of employees in full-time equivalents was 1,613.

Predominantly banking-based financial group. Main unit is SNS Bank Nederland. Also has specialised banks, BLG Hypotheken and CVB Bank. Sanesa unit groups leasing and consumer loans business. Insurer NOG Verzekeringen joined SNS group in 1994. In 1995 net interest income from banking accounted for 73 pct of group income. Total insurance income in 1995 was 542 million guilders. At end of 1995 SNS Groep NV had total assets of 27.51 billion guilders and equity capital of 1.45 billion. In 1995 average number of employees (full-time equivalents) was 2,787.
